authorityRules: The operational installer independently pins the authenticated installation digest, exact signed recipient bytes, eligible issuer, generation, environment and workload credential/principal/epoch. A staged candidate or public request is not an installation authority.

The only initial consumer is LS-FACT-BRIDGE resolving SECRET-DB-CREDENTIAL for POSTGRES_CONNECT to STORE-CANDIDATE-INDEX-PG under the compiled least-privilege consumer descriptor. Secret bytes are absent.

Only verified TLS peer authentication with committed Identity evidence followed by current participant, privacy, principal, credential and installed-recipient fences permits the owning resolver to consider this exact reference/version.

An installed signature is not complete configuration readiness, provider delivery, database session fencing, rotation approval or effect authority. Each downstream owner must separately establish its obligation.
Revoked or expired binding, stale installation/generation, wrong role/workload/scope/reference/version or ambiguous binding blocks delivery; no fallback or resurrection is permitted.
